items.title: Lennar (LEN) Opens New Home Communities In Madison And Valencia
items.summary: Lennar (NYSE:LEN) announced grand openings for new single family home communities in Madison, Alabama, and Valencia, California. The Madison community, Hitching Post Farms, targets buyers seeking modern amenities and access to local schools and outdoor attractions. The Valencia communities, Sutton and Hollis, focus on higher access locations for commuters along with nearby services and recreation. items.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Is Buying These 2 Homebuilding Stocks. Housing Market Recovery Coming?
items.summary: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway, which is now run by Greg Abel, revealed in its latest 13F filing that the fund bought a new stake in D.R. Horton (NYSE:DHI), worth about $580,000.
